notes.title: May bug fixes
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] re-enabled track selector; press trigger button to cycle through available tracks
[*] added a brake button as the alternative method to reverse the buggy
[*] the coffee table is now available as teleportation target in some tracks
[*] tweaked the lap penalty mechanics
[*] added 1 new track and 1 new part (no. 28)
[/olist]

notes.title: Multiplayer Fix #2
notes.notes: fixed a bug where host player cannot control the buggy

notes.title: Multiplayer fix
notes.notes:
Multiplayer feature is still unstable/unpolished but it should be in a better state now:
[list]
[*] made some changes to the lobby UI to makes thing more intuitive
[*] lobby name should now be pre-populated
[*] fixed some bugs specific to connectivity
[*] disable vibrations
[/list]
Please let me know if you notice any bugs, thanks!

notes.title: 2020 update
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] updated game to latest SteamVR to support index controllers
[*] snap turn is now available
[*] added RC transmitter
[*] added a lobby UI to multiplayer mode (requires right hand controller to point-and-click)
[/olist]

notes.title: August Update 2
notes.notes:
- added a new track
- fix an issue where the player buggy's indicator triangle wobbles strangely
- adjust the snap distance threshold for attaching wheels

notes.title: Multiplayer (beta) added
notes.notes:
- added an option to race against another player 
- added a new single player track
- added a new paint job

please let me know on forum if you find any bugs. 

Have a nice summer.
